'''Ben Rodriguez''' (also published as '''Ben Rodrigez''' and '''Ben Rodriguz''') is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Chewbacca Con]] on 28 July 2001 with [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor Ops]], according to Michael Pistone's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2756">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-31-madskills-at-boxborough-july-28th-day-1d2756/ madskills-at-boxborough-july-28th-day-1], DeckTech (Michael "MadSkills84" Pistone, 31 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-31-madskills-at-boxborough-july-28th-day-1d2756/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
